The Nur Mahal palace is located near Bahawalpur, in the Bahawalpur District of the Punjab region, eastern Pakistan. It is an eclectic Neoclassical palace, with Indo-Saracenic Revival and Italianate villa design elements and features, completed in 1875. It belonged to the Nawab of the Bahawalpur princely state (1802–1955), during the British Raj (colonial British India) era. It is presently a historic house museum.
